decisions.reason: After an active 2018 launch, the product disappeared from the website by 2019, so for a medium-sized firm with many adjacent options this suggests the market test revealed too little standalone value to justify keeping the option open.

A GIS solution-building platform fits the firm's strategic direction in integrated enterprise geospatial solutions and its increased visibility by 2019 indicates enough promise to continue investing while the upside remains significant.
Mobile field data capture is closely aligned with core customer use cases and remained actively presented across years, so the option appears valuable and still worth maintaining and developing.

The product was still being versioned and promoted in 2019, and as a close-to-core extension with relatively low carrying costs it is rational to keep it on the market while exploiting complementarities with the firm's web map offerings.
